'''Quintad Orbital Manufacturing''', also known as '''QOM''', was a manufacturing firm that operated in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] served as an executive of QOM and during his tenure, he brokered a number of lease agreements with various Republic military manufacturers for the hire of space in QOM's [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and factories. In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], Tarkin was appointed as the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and he turned control of QOM over to [[Ranulph Tarkin's cousin|one of his cousins]].
